sec: Sheehan syndrome clinical course and lymphocytic hypophysitis DDx

items.q: What is the earliest clinical manifestation of Sheehan syndrome appearing immediately after hospital discharge?
items.exp: Lactational failure immediately after discharge is the earliest clinical manifestation of Sheehan syndrome. (Book p955)

items.q: At what postpartum interval do the full clinical features of panhypopituitarism most commonly manifest in Sheehan syndrome?
items.exp: The most common interval for presentation of Sheehan syndrome is 3-4 months after delivery. (Book p955)

items.q: Match the sellar pathology to its characteristic prolactin polarity — 1) Pituitary apoplexy 2) Sheehan's syndrome … A) Hypopituitarism with hyperprolactinemia (stalk effect) B) Hypopituitarism with hypoprolactinemia (lactotroph necrosis)
items.exp: Pituitary apoplexy produces hypopituitarism + hyperprolactinemia, whereas Sheehan syndrome produces hypopituitarism + hypoprolactinemia. (Book p955)

items.q: A 31-year-old woman presents 4 months following an obstetric hemorrhage with amenorrhea, extreme fatigue, breast atrophy, and premature fine wrinkling around her eyes and mouth. What condition is present?
items.exp: Sheehan syndrome presents at 3-4 months with fatigue, hypoglycemia, lactational failure, secondary amenorrhea, facial wrinkling, hair loss, and breast atrophy. (Book p955)

items.q: Which cutaneous or physical finding is NOT typical of chronic hypogonadism in Sheehan syndrome?
items.exp: Sheehan syndrome causes facial wrinkling, hair loss, hypopigmentation, and breast atrophy; hirsutism/seborrhea are not seen. (Book p955)

items.q: Why are diabetes insipidus and posterior pituitary features exceptionally rare in Sheehan syndrome?
opts: The posterior lobe receives direct arterial blood supply from the inferior hypophyseal artery
Magnocellular hypothalamic neurons do not require vascular perfusion
Oxytocin and ADH synthesis shifts entirely to the median eminence
Pregnancy stimulates compensatory neovascularization of the stalk
items.exp: Posterior pituitary / ADH features are rare in Sheehan syndrome because the posterior lobe has independent arterial perfusion. (Book p955)

items.q: Match the postpartum sellar disorder to its characteristic pathology — 1) Sheehan's syndrome 2) Lymphocytic hypophysitis … A) Post-partum ischemic necrosis B) Post-partum inflammatory IgG4-related mass lesion
items.exp: Sheehan syndrome is postpartum ischemic necrosis; lymphocytic hypophysitis is an autoimmune inflammatory IgG4-related mass. (Book p955)

items.q: Assess the differential features of lymphocytic hypophysitis versus Sheehan syndrome: I Lymphocytic hypophysitis can occur in males, females, and children and exhibits excellent response to corticosteroids. II Sheehan syndrome demonstrates an empty sella on MRI, whereas lymphocytic hypophysitis presents as an enhancing pituitary mass.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Lymphocytic hypophysitis is an IgG4 mass in males/females/children responding to steroids; Sheehan syndrome shows empty sella and lacks autoimmune markers. (Book p955)

items.q: What is the typical neuroimaging finding on pituitary MRI in long-standing Sheehan syndrome?
opts: Unilocular cystic mass with machinery oil
items.exp: Imaging in Sheehan syndrome characteristically shows a secondary empty sella. (Book p955)

items.q: Unlike Sheehan syndrome which is non-autoimmune, lymphocytic hypophysitis is frequently associated with systemic ___ disease.
items.exp: Lymphocytic hypophysitis is an IgG4-related autoimmune disorder. (Book p955)

items.q: A 29-year-old postpartum woman in a developed country presents with headache, hyperprolactinemia, and central diabetes insipidus. Sellar MRI reveals a pituitary mass lesion with avid homogeneous enhancement that rapidly shrinks following high-dose dexamethasone. This is:
items.exp: Lymphocytic hypophysitis features a postpartum mass, elevated prolactin, frequent DI, and dramatic response to corticosteroid therapy. (Book p955)

items.q: Which characteristic differentiates lymphocytic hypophysitis from Sheehan syndrome?
items.exp: Lymphocytic hypophysitis shows a pituitary mass, autoimmune features, DI, and hyperprolactinemia; empty sella is characteristic of Sheehan. (Book p955)
